extracted.name: Stuffed onion
ingredient_lines: 1 cup ground meat beef or lamb
Salt,pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, turmeric, all spices
instruction_lines: Cut the onion head clean the skin slice in half not all way till you get to the heart then stop
Boil the onion over medium heat for 15 minutes drain and cool with your fingers the cool cook onion start peeling easy don’t worry
Mix the stuffing and use full tablespoon of it and stuff the onion and roll it
Get the sauce ready heat it up add it over onions cook in the oven at 500 f for 10 minutes when you see the broth boiling cover the onion reduce the heat to 350 and cook for 40 minutes enjoy
